en: The Lord is merciful... I am not.
I don't get to walk the Righteous path. I blaze the trail so that others may do so safely.
Evil stirs in New York... and so the Vatican has called on me.
I am the Sword of Saint Benedict!
I've taken the Venator's oath. My life belongs not to me, but to service.
We all have a callin'--the only question is, do we have the courage to answer it?
Less than two dozen men and women have the honor of being called Venator. The title is a source of much pride... the work that I am sometimes called to do, less so.
Today the hunter prays for your blessing, and absolution.
Today... nine Commandments will have to do.
Ours is not to question what is necessary. Ours is to have the will to do whatever it takes.
I must report to my superiors.
I must prepare for the hunt.
I'm still recoverin' from the last hunt.
I still have parishes to investigate.
I'm not ready to pass judgement yet.
The Carnifex Rite is not somethin' to be taken lightly.
It's not the right time to strike...
I don't question what needs to be done, I question the timing!
I know better than to rush into things.
You should have handed over the Tome the moment it came into your possession.
Last I checked this doesn't belong to the Vatican.
No. But I'm the only one I trust to get rid of it.
I'm talking to you aren't I?
Didn't expect to see you again.
I can't tell if you're happy or disappointed.
Hate my methods all you want, I saved lives.
There was a way to save more.

No, there was a way to risk more, and God help us all if we failed. I don't blame you for not having the stomach to do what needed to be done, but sleep easy knowing that what happened in that brownstone is my burden alone, not yours.
You're a good man, detective. If this is my last battle, I'm happy to have it be with you.
You're the one destined for greatness, right?
No, I'm great now. I'm just waiting for the world to catch up with the times so I can show it.
Men like you call people like me demons, so no. I don't trust you.
Young man, I don't care about the circumstances of your birth, I care about who you are. I don't give a damn if you look like a monster… but if you act like one, I will put you down.
Yep, I definitely don't trust you.
Follow my lead, and we'll get through this.
It's adorable that you think you're in charge. Please, share more of your august knowledge on how to survive this
I know what I'm talking about.
No, you think you do. And there's a world of difference between experience and unearned arrogance.
I don't think I've ever seen a priest like you before.
That's good. It means your life hasn't been in peril.
Father, I'm not a religious man. Not a man at all, really. But… would you mind saying a prayer for Miss Shelly?
M-m, of course... Lord, please guide Bebop's hand. May his aim be true, and his resolve unshaken by the screams of his enemies. For he fights not for himself, but for the life of a good woman. Amen.
That was significantly more violent than I expected.
Lay your traps Father, I'll be sure to pull them right towards them.
I'm not lookin' to chit-chat with a murderer.
What, so you never talk to your fellow Venators?
Don't try to equivocate with me, Calico.
You have no moral high ground.
Wrong. I have no illusions that my hands are clean, but at least when innocent people die by my hand, it's not because I'm lookin' to make a dollar.
You assume that the people I kill are innocent.
Don't pretend that you bother to check.
Oh come on, we worked well together.
That was before you became a monster.
Seeing you dote on that cat is nauseating.
I'm a multifaceted individual, Father. I'm allowed to show affection.
You and I both know that for the right price you'd slit her throat.
Cover your ears Ava, the bad man has no idea what he's talking about.
We're about be shot at, and you're dressed like you just got off a shift at the circus. So yes. I have concerns.
It's the sideshow, but close enough.
You've seen what you look like, right?
Do you always make judgements on appearances?
I mean, you're either gonna start screamin' Latin and shootin' people, or you're gonna do a burlesque act. And somethin' tells me that cassock ain't tear-away.
Lord willing, you'll survive and get to hear 'em.
Ah. I see we're both familiar with each other's work. How lovely.
Next time you visit New York, you should stay at The Baroness.
Oh, The Baroness definitely has my attention...
Wonderful! Any time you wish to enjoy our hospitality, please let me know. I'll make sure to attend to it personally.
Merely a simple servant, just like you.
After the ritual's complete, I'm going to drive a stake in your heart.
You've never fought a man like me before.
Enjoy your last day of wanton slaughter, Drifter. Tomorrow your wretched life will come to an end.
I'm not interested in your musings, vampire.
Possessed, currently. But you know Julian!
You need to have a class to explain to people that making a deal with the Devil is a bad idea?
Stay close to me, Professor, I'll keep ya safe.
You're in over your head, child.
Believe me, Father, I already regret meeting you.
What kind of priest carries a gun?
One that's about to go to war. What kind of child traffics with the dead?
One that- ugh, I don't do purple prose. I do. I traffic with the dead. If you have a problem with that, you shouldn't be here.
Oh my God, someone religious is being closed minded, I wish I wore pearls so I could clutch them.
It's a real shame that you're not going to live long enough to learn the wisdom that comes with age.
Threaten ya? I'm trying to save your life.
Thanks for your concern, I can take things from here.
Heard you left the Baxter Society.
You're starin' into the abyss, Wesley. We both know where that leads.
The last year was hard, but we've been blessed as of late.
Your choice in protégé was... interesting.
If he strays from the path, you won't be able to protect him from us.
I think I work with a friend of yours.
Tell the bastard I said hi.
You ever work with a Venator before?
Well, just to set expectations, we can be… a bit exhuberant in our methods.
I appreciate the importance of being thorough.
Then we should have no problems.
Today, the wicked will suffer at our hands.
What happened in Macomb wasn't your fault, child.
No... but I've failed before. You can't let it consume you.
I didn't say don't care. Pain and anger are fires that burn in all of us, but it needs to be tended lest it destroys you.
Yeah? And how do you tend it?
Harden your heart, Sheriff. You can't let your sense of law and order get in the way of what needs to be done.
Don't worry, Father. The law is the farthest thing from driving me.
Thanks for praying with me earlier.
I hope it... brought you some peace.
It didn't. But it was nice that you tried!
I'd hate to see what kind of homilies you're dropping on Sundays.
I don't serve at a parish.
I'm next to a crazy preacher with a gun. Why wouldn't I be?
What nuance am I missin' here?!
Ain't you heard? The whole city's haunted.
...I really thought I buried this part of me, y'know.
A lot of people try to bury the past. Problem with that is whenever someone comes to go dig it up, they make a big mess.
Yeah. Win. Otherwise you're torturing yourself for second place, and that's not worth it.
You certainly knew who to bribe.
When this is over, I'm cutting off your arm.
You can't fight evil with evil.
Why do you look so nervous?
Jeanne... Venators only hunt the wicked. What could you possibly have done to be worried about someone like me?
Don't worry. I'll shepherd you home.
I thought priests were supposed to be nice.
I'm pretty sure you're about to kill people.
Are you sure you're a priest?
I don't expect you to understand the nuance of my world.
Nuance sounds like a big word.
Don't worry about it. Just know I'll protect you.
You say that now, but you'll like me.
Did your masters at the Vatican send you? [Gasps] Or are you thinking for yourself for a change?
The fact that there's not a stake through your heart should be answer enough.
You killed a friend of mine.
[Laughter] Oh, please! You're still willing to work with me? I killed a work acquaintance at best.
Aren't you planning on offering me a benediction?
Thought you were in the business of saving souls?
You'd have to have one first.
I don't know what Wesley saw in you...
From what I heard, it's more like three-quarters.
How much longer do you think you can keep the charade up?
You're not gonna stab me in the back, are ya?
Let me guess... "I'm gonna stab you in the front"?
I'm not stabbing you, period. You're a werewolf... I'm going to shoot you with silver bullets.
Got a problem working with me?
The Venators are a results-centric order.
Bet that covers all manner of sins.
I was going to ask you the same thing!
Damn. Wanna get a round after the ritual if we don't wind up dead?
You are the Vatican's killer, yes?
Good. Better you than someone with morals.
How many heads have you taken with that sword?
I'm not psychotic enough to keep track, or weak enough to remember.
Harden your heart, Yamato. We have work to do.
Don't worry, Venator. I've never been plagued with a soft heart.
Fire saves more lives than it takes.
They will be wreathed in flame!
The fire of justice will burn.
Hard to heal when you're on fire.
I need to be able to wear them down.
Here's a taste of what awaits them!
Silver and cold iron buckshot should do the trick.
I long for the day when this will be a plowshare.
It is the Lord who judges. I merely facilitate the introduction.
I stun 'em, then I'll finish 'em off!
What did you expect? A crucifix and chanting?
I will never kneel before the likes of you.
The Lord has plans for me...
All they'll be able to do is stand there and burn.
New York needs my help, and I can't let its people down.
Once I trap 'em they'll be easy to finish off.
If they don't walk into this, I'll knock 'em into it.
I got a little suprise for 'em.
Ready to pull out the crossbow.
Ancient evil calls for ancient tools.
The wicked will die at my hand!
I'll drive a stake through their heart!
Sometimes the old ways are the best.
I don't plan on showing mercy.
Preparing the tools of the trade.
In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti. (In the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.)
Domine, protege me, dum impios interficio. (Lord, protect me while I kill the wicked.)
They will learn to fear me.
They can run, but it only will delay the inevitable.
Time to end their miserable existence!
A Venator doesn't traffic in mercy.
Ego sum ira Domini. (I am the wrath of the Lord.)
The Lord still has plans for me.
I'll kill as many as I can!
In nomine Patris... et Filii... et Spiritus Sancti. (In the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.)
My work will not be deterred.
They picked a side--and now they will reap what they sowed!
Let me be stained by the blood of the wicked!
Eternal rest be unto them, o Lord... and may perpetual light shine upon them.
You were never going to kill me.
You've never fought a man like me.
I don't fear people like you.
I don't mind working with my hands.
These hands aren't made to comfort.
Wealth will not buy you mercy.
The mighty will be toppled from their tower.
We must lean on each other to win.
We need to keep this up.
The Righteous have nothing to fear from me.
A Venator will not be denied.
The tithe will be paid in blood.
No one is going to stop me!
I won't stop until all of them are dead.
I am the flood that washes the earth clean...
The Lord will shield me from their power!
Can't forget to upgrade my powers.
I might want to get an item.
I need to see what they have at the store.
The Curiosity Shop might have something I need.
Wonder what I can afford now.
I've saved up a good amount of souls.
I need to be wise about what I buy.
No point in savin' more than this.
I need to spend these souls.
Those souls are waitin' to be picked up.
Venators rely on donations like these.
Every soul gets me closer to what I need.
The souls don't matter, we took the objective.
They can keep a few souls, it doesn't matter.
The objective fell, and that's what's important.
You can't hide from a Venator.
It's not my time to die.
I've gotten out of worse jams.
I could be walkin' into a trap.
Need to be careful not to overexpose myself.
A Venator is used to working alone.
I'll try to hold them off.
I'm ready to rise to the challenge.
I need to be smart here...
Now all we need is a plan.
It's time to capitalize on the advantage!
They're going to be coming for us.
We need to finish the ritual.
It's time to summon the Patron.
And now, we do what we came here to do.
Let's finish them off, once and for all.
You're on your own for now.
Evil stirs in New York... and so the Vatican has called on me.
I wish I could save you all.
They won't stand a chance against us.
Once a Venator's dispatched, no one but God can stop them.
The Vatican gave me my assignment, and I will not fail.
Man will try to stop my divine work, but they will fail.
Death awaits any who stand between me and my mission.
Thank you for fighting beside me today. The Venators will not forget this.
I've never seen a man take such punishment.
The golem is a cruel one, isn't he.
Dynamo's keepin' me in a fight.
Your aim's as steady as ever, Talon.
Always a pleasure to work with the Baxter Society.
I knew we could count on Talon.
Grey Talon is vigilant as always.
The Sandman is beautiful to behold.
It's always nice to see a professional work.
Not bad, Infernus. Not bad at all.
It's an honour to fight with you, Ivy.
Time to finish what Geist started!
I was saved by a mole man! These are strange times!
That man belonged in Lost Whisper.
He's a monster... but today he's my monster.
Seven is more powerful than I thought!
He fights like a man possessed!
I get what Talon saw in him.
Shiv is still in the fight!
The Cube truly is a gift.
Ho-ho, Viscous, this is sinfully relaxing.
He truly is a man of conviction.
Abrams is strong... but my will was stronger.
Give me the damn Tome, Abrams!
Help me kill Abrams, damn it!
He had his whole life ahead of him.
He threw away his future the moment he stood with that lot.
I don't like snuffing out potential but it had to be done.
Poor lad had no idea who he was fightin' for.
The fencer has been dealt with.
I'll pray for Shelly Fisher, Bebop.
I'm sorry, Bebop. Your mother's needs don't outweigh the world's.
The scrap golem had heart... but heart doesn't win wars.
The scrap golem has been dispatched.
I wasn't gonna let you stop me, Bebop!
You're not an iconoclast, you're a cliché.
Look on the bright side, Billy: I gave you something new to complain about.
You shouldn't have picked a fight with me, Billy.
The black sheep of the Baxter Society is dead.
I hope your thirty pieces of silver was worth it, Calico.
You fancy yourself an aristocrat, but you're just a petty woman with petty aspirations.
You were never going to kill me, Calico.
She should have stayed in the circus.
Showmen don't make for great fighters.
Almost feel bad about that one.
The unicorn isn't a threat anymore.
I need to speak to the others about the Baroness.
What the hell is that thing?
Hell is too good for him.
I was put on this Earth to kill men like you, Drifter!
I will stop you, Drifter, no matter the cost.
Science only takes you so far, professor.
You're not a fighter, Dynamo, don't try to be.
Why are you working with them, professor?
Cut off the support and the rest will die soon enough.
Look out for the black hole!
The dead are nothing to play with, child.
This is the path that liches lead the innocent down.
The dead are meant to stay buried!
She was in over her head.
Peace never lasts for men like us.
I'll pray for your family, Grey Talon.
I don't blame him for being consumed by anger.
I don't always agree with the Baxter Society, but I've always respected 'em.
Glad he's not in his prime.
The OSIC is not in control here, Haze!
I respect you, Haze, but you stood in my way.
I don't answer to the OSIC.
You can't shroud my mind, Haze!
Perhaps some divine intervention was at work.
Leave the Troubadour to me, sheriff.
You picked the wrong side, Holliday.
The people of Macomb deserve better than her!
Run, sheriff. I'll be coming for you soon enough.
I'm not scared of a sheriff who let her town down.
You won't be so lucky next time, Holliday.
I don't fear the flames, Infernus.
I would gladly walk through the fire, Infernus.
Fire will never kill me, Infernus. It will only forge me into something stronger.
You chose this path, Infernus, and now you reap the rewards.
I don't fear the flames of demons.
I'm sorry I have to do this, Ivy.
Why are you helping them, Ivy?
Wake up, Ivy! You're fightin' on the wrong side!
I have nothing to fear from the gargoyle.
And so the gargoyle flies away like the craven huntress she is.
The power coursing through Kelvin is unlike anything I've ever encountered before.
The ice wight is dead... but he'll be back.
Your life ended in the Arctic, Kelvin.
That abomination is a ghoulish mockery of life!
Kelvin, all you do is torture yourself by prolonging the inevitable!
I'll stop you, Kelvin, wherever you roam.
The ice won't be your salvation, Kelvin.
Your unnatural life has come to an end.
Your days of leeching on the lives of others is over, Geist.
No one will mourn you, Geist.
Don't get close to Lady Geist!
Geist is looking to spring a trap.
Lash, the only thing impressive about you is your moustache.
Humility will serve you well, Lash.
Lash, you could be so much more if you believe in something other than yourself.
You've never fought something like me, Lash.
Lash got the death he deserved.
That was lovely watching Lash's fall from grace.
Your tools of war won't be enough, McGinnis.
The avarice of Fairfax Industries ends today.
Pride will make a loser out of anyone.
I'll tear through your little horde of machines.
Mina, you needed a little dose of reality.
You're not special, Mina. You're just a brat.
You're not better than anyone, Mina.
You won't be feedin' on my friends, Mina.
He was a man of duty and honour.
In another life we could've been friends.
Only one of us can complete the ritual, Mirage.
A shame we can't be working together, boys.
I'll give them some whiskey later, they'll be fine.
They're decent fellas... just have a terrible choice of friends.
I can't let you stop me, Krill.
Poor thing had no idea what she was in for.
This isn't a story, Paige! This is the real world!
I'm sorry, Paige. Your brother is beyond saving.
She's thrown away her life to save someone who doesn't deserve it!
I'm not interested in your games, Paradox.
I don't find your antics amusing, Paradox.
The other Venators will buy me a drink for killing her.
Your delusions of grandeur fall short, Paradox.
Pocket, you picked a bad time to come back to New York.
Fairfax Industries needs to be ripped out, root and stem.
You meddle with thing you couldn't possibly understand, child.
Go back to whatever hole you've crawled out of.
I'm not fallin' for the cute façade.
Furry bastard got what he deserved.
We all must answer for our crimes eventually, Seven!
Some secrets were not meant for man.
A monster like him deserved to die.
There is no redeeming you, Shiv.
I know what you've done, Shiv.
You have many crimes to answer for, Shiv.
The Baxter Society was never going to be able to protect you from me.
The werewolf is no longer a threat.
Silver won't be huntin' us for a while.
I'll separate your souls for you.
The magician is no threat to us.
Sinclair is out of the picture.
Victor, quit moping around and try to live a life!
The answers you're looking for are going to elude you today, Victor.
I took down the walking cadaver.
You confuse revenge with justice, Vindicta.
You lost your way a long time ago, Vindicta.
Her hatred used to be focused, but it's become indiscriminant.
The sky offers no safety, Vindicta.
Being ignorant of the world doesn't make you immune from consequences!
I won't let you prey on my friends, Vyper.
That woman would kill her own mother for a nickel.
The desperate are the most dangerous.
Only way it was going to end, Warden.
I can tell by the way he fights that this isn't the life he would've chosen.
You're not at my level, Warden.
Your days of extorting people are numbered, Wraith!
You're not going to intimidate me, Wraith.
I'm not some petty crock you can boss around, Yamato.
She knows how to use a sword, I'll give her that.
I'm not losing to you, Yamato.
I'll be back when I can, Venator.
At least he's hunting them, not me.
I won't be hunted like some pathetic vampire.
You don't have what it takes to stop me, Father.
Hey Padre, what's the Latin word for "I just got my ass kicked"?
Oh, ohh, the Vatican's comin' for me now!
Try explaining that you lost to a guy with a goat head to your superiors.
I don't know what the hell a Venator is, but it's dead.
The Father was out of his mind!
Hate to see what sort of congregation that guy has...
Father Quinn needed to be stopped!
Why is the Vatican after me?
Your mission is doomed to fail, Venator!
Run back to your handlers while you still can!
You've never faced someone like me before, Cain.
I'm not some petty vampire that you can just stake!
You should have trained harder, Venator.
You know, Cain, one day you will actually believe the legend you sell to people, and on that day you will die screaming.
I know you're prepared to die here, Venator, which is good, because you shall.
When's the Vatican gonna give up?
I expected more from the Sword of St. Benedict.
How many of your order do I gotta kill before you realize you can't stop me?
God ain't coming to save you, Venator.
Come out and play, Venator... Don't be scared.
I won't let you stop me, Venator!
Wish the Venator was fighting for us.
I've seen a few venators in my time... that one was angrier than most.
So much for a friendly rivalry.
The picked the wrong side, father.
A shame. The other Venators I met were more reasonable.
You can't help but admire his commitment.
Go back to Europe, father. The OSIC has it from here.
I've seen some crazy preachers before, but that's a new one.
I'm going to hell, aren't I?
Probably shouldn't tell the folks back home about this.
Get out of my way, Father!
I think it's time you go back home, Venator.
You're picking the wrong fight, Venator!
I, uh... I probably shouldn't tell the Arroyos about this.
Sooo, the Vatican sent an assassin? That's... great.
I never thought I'd be at war with the Vatican!
Come, Venator, and learn that I'm not easy prey!
You'll have to try harder, Venator!
You don't have what it takes to stop me, Venator!
You made a mistake coming here, Venator.
It's time for you to leave New York, Venator.
You think I was just gonna let you hunt me?
You're just a man, Rourke, and you're gonna die screaming like one.
I won't be hunted by the likes of you!
You picked the wrong prey, Venator.
The Djinn will be protected from the likes of you.
We will not be hunted by the likes of you.
We don't answer to the Vatican!
Why do I get the feeling he'd turn us into a rug if he had the chance?
I thought you were supposed to hunt monsters!
The last thing I needed in my life was that guy trying to hunt me down!
Was wondering when they'd send you after me.
Knew this was bound to happen one day.
I don't know much about priests, but I don't think they're supposed to shoot people.
He was like a big leprechaun with a gun.
He looks scary, but cool scary, not monster scary.
I pulled the pin, now what do I do?
Today keeps getting better and better!
I'm not afraid of you, Venator.
You've never hunted anyone like me before, Father!
To suffer is divine, isn't it, Venator?
See ya at the bar later, Father.
I'm not impressed by a fancy title.
He'll be back, I know it.
He'll come back to kill me, and I'll be ready.
You came a long way just to fail, Venator.
Your mission was doomed to fail, Venator.
You should never have made me your target, Venator.
You know, you'd think the Vatican could afford better assassins.
What the hell did I do to get the Venator sent after me?
Oh, I could listen to that guy read me the phone book. He is killing me. Heh ha!
信じるものを間違えたな。
バチカンの力はこの程度か。
私に勝つことなど、不可能なのだ。
Venator, I know you have no love for the Hidden King, but the Archmother is a tyrant! And together, we can usurp her!
I know you question if this is the right course of action, Venator... but it is. The Archmother threatens us all!
Thank you for realising that the Hidden King is not your enemy today. May your hunt be successful, Venator.
Venator, your faith is like iron, your fury righteous, and both will be needed to stop the Archmother!
You have slain the things of people's nightmares, but you have never faced someone like the Archmother. Together with the Hidden King, you have a way to free New York from her grip.
The Sword of Saint Benedict cuts them down like wheat!
Oh, how the Archmother's chosen cower before the Venator!
The Venator offers absolution to his allies!
The Venator is relentless in his hunt.
The Hidden King is a threat to everyone, Venator. Good luck on your hunt.
Father Quinn, I know you question if this is the right course of action, but it is! The Hidden King threatens us all.
Thank you for realising that the Archmother is not your enemy today. May your hunt be successful, Father.
Venator... your faith is like iron, your fury righteous, and both will be needed to stop the Hidden King!
You have slain the things of people's nightmares, but you have never faced someone like the Hidden King. Together, with the Archmother, you have a way to end his reign!
The Sword of Saint Benedict cuts them down like wheat!
Oh, how the disciples of the Hidden King cower before Father Quinn!
The Venator strikes fear in our enemies!
Hope that guy doesn't teach Sunday School.
God may protect... but sometimes the big man upstairs needs a helping hand.
There are few safer places to be than under a Venator’s protection.
I don’t feel a burning desire to join you on the hunt, so if you could just drop me off that would be wonderful.
I don’t suppose you could pick up the pace, Father?
If you would be so kind, could we focus on efficiency as opposed to pageantry?
I know it’s a lot to ask, but if you could not run angry–that would be great.
